what_this_is: The rows of docs/curves/registry.json that the cover catalog certifies: docs/curves/covers.json and docs/curves/cover-links.yaml carry one finding and one graph node for each slug named here, in registry order, and bind them by catalog_rows_sha256, the SHA-256 of the sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON of {"schema_version": <registry schema_version>, "curves": [the named rows, in registry order]}. Registry rows not named here (for example the isogeny-volcano census curves the registry builder sweeps in from research JSON) do not change that digest, so adding them leaves the cover report, the link graph, the cover-transfer assessment and the IC leaderboard roster current.
how_to_extend: Adding a curve to the cover catalog is an explicit, reviewed change: append its ICV1 slug here, then run cargo run --bin curve_cover_check --, node scripts/build_cover_transfer_assessments.mjs --write (after updating its row-count assertions), python3 scripts/build_ic_leaderboard.py and python3 scripts/build_lab_browser.py. A slug named here that the registry does not hold fails every one of them.
membership_origin: every row of docs/curves/registry.json at sha256 584d070fbec7e21fd3f6b9ec31bc4d0ee533ce66da76a07fed0d818e5ae3a1cf, the registry the cover catalog was built and frozen against before aburan28/crypto#2446 added 13,219 volcano census curves
